individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph montage, not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of raw intensity traces over time (with fitted curves) and insets averaging early time points; line plots are exempt from requiring an overlay of individual data points.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A is a micrograph montage with no plotted error bars.
FAIL - The insets show average early time-point responses with vertical error bars, but the caption does not state what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
